title: Enforce verified email and Firestore allowlist lookup inside server verifyIdToken

violation.problem: verifyIdToken in studio/src/lib/firebase-admin.ts returns decoded.uid immediately after adminAuth().verifyIdToken(...) without verifying decoded.email_verified === true or checking adminDb().collection('allowlist').doc(email).get(). Because server API routes (/api/narrations/*) use adminDb() and adminBucket() (which bypass Firestore Security Rules), non-allowlisted or revoked users can trigger Gemini TTS synthesis and server-side mutations.
violation.expectedSolution: Normalize `decoded.email?.trim().toLowerCase()`, require `decoded.email_verified === true`, and verify `(await adminDb().collection('allowlist').doc(email).get()).exists` inside `verifyIdToken` before returning `decoded.uid`.

forbiddenPatterns:
const decoded = await adminAuth().verifyIdToken(token.trim(), true);
    return decoded.uid;
